summary: Mobile decl-veracidade checkbox fix verified. At 390x844 the checkbox is display:block and sits fully above the text on both /inscricao.html and /dados-inscricao.html (checkbox bottom <= text top, text starts at the label's left padding). Clicking it still checks it. At 1920 desktop it stays inline-block beside the text, so desktop is unchanged. On dados-inscricao at 390px, after the required selects (POLO, VAGA, MUNICIPIO_PROVA) were filled, the Cadastrar button was disabled before the box was checked and enabled after.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is a single @media(max-width:767px) rule at the end of /app/memory/home_build/pages.css (display:block; float/position reset; margin 0 0 10px). Fine.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Measure with a Range from after the checkbox to the end of the label (getClientRects) to get the text's top and left. Button enabling was checked on dados-inscricao only; the inscricao.html validateForm logic was not changed by the CSS.
